{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure consistency
trial = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Check if the treatment arm distribution differs by sex (confounding check)
confounding_check = pd.crosstab(trial['sex'], trial['arm'])
print("Cross-tabulation of sex and treatment arm:")
print(confounding_check)

# Compute response rates by sex and arm to see if the difference is consistent across arms
response_by_sex_arm = trial.groupby(['sex', 'arm'])['responded'].mean().unstack(level='arm')
print("\nResponse rates by sex and arm:")
print(response_by_sex_arm)

# Compute the difference in response rates within each arm to assess if sex effect is consistent
within_arm_diff = response_by_sex_arm['treatment'] - response_by_sex_arm['control']
print("\nDifference in response rate (treatment - control) by sex:")
print(within_arm_diff)"}
